<!-- Source page: Nano -->

[Nano](https://www.nano-editor.org/) is a simple, lightweight command-line text editor. It is a popular choice for quick edits in the terminal.

On NixOS, is installed by default.

## Configuration

System-wide nano configurations are defined through the option. Refer to the [nanorc man page](https://www.nano-editor.org/dist/latest/nanorc.5.html) for a full list of settings.

For a full list of nano module options, see .
